# Lemmy community fixture

`group_01919.json` is the canonical Group example from Lemmy's
`crates/apub/assets/lemmy/objects/group.json`, copied from source commit
`6c9bc1ce80d12cf1cdb1924e91d5740e91ff7601` (Cargo workspace version 0.19.19).
The public example key is fixture data. The community directory/detail records
in `discovery_communities.rs` follow that version's `Community`, `CommunityView`,
`ListCommunitiesResponse` and `GetCommunityResponse` structures.

Source: <https://github.com/LemmyNet/lemmy/tree/6c9bc1ce80d12cf1cdb1924e91d5740e91ff7601>.
Upstream is licensed under AGPL-3.0. These tests cover the v3 wire contract;
they do not claim live interoperability with other API versions.
